dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: I must... I must win. Even just once.

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: If we're talking careers, I'm a matra of the Akademiya. You don't have to be nervous. It's not my working hours now.

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: Under the strict supervision of the General Mahamatra, the spreading of banned knowledge and academic corruption in the Akademiya has decreased significantly. Thanks to Lord Cyno, us subordinates' vacations have also become more frequent.

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: Many students often have meals together in this café, but most of their conversations are just regular chats.

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: Although the matra are in charge of many things, they are not responsible for collecting students' evaluations and opinions about their mentors.

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: So right now, I am just an ordinary person of Sumeru who is enjoying coffee while studying card strategies.

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: Don't you know? It's Genius Invokation TCG, the greatest craze in all of Sumeru, maybe even in all of Teyvat!

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: The varied decks, the unpredictable turns... It is all so fascinating.

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: That's how all my vacation was just somehow spent playing cards, or studying how to play.

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: Goodbye, I already have an idea...

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: You think so, too? Then you should come to Puspa Café more often. It has people fighting tooth and nail every day!

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: I mean fighting in Genius Invokation TCG, of course. If someone started an actual fight, the acting manager would flip out before I did.

dialogues.speaker: Nayab
dialogues.text: Say, are you free now? I want to show you the new deck I built, and maybe you can help me figure out how I can win with it?
